name: @devdogsuga/study-group-finder
comment: Turborepo task wrapper for the Flutter app. The real toolchain is Flutter/Dart; these scripts shell out to it via `dotenvx run` so the Flutter build reads the shared root .env. Requires the Flutter SDK on PATH.

scripts.generate-types: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env -- sh -c 'SUPABASE_URL=$API_URL SUPABASE_API_KEY=$SECRET_KEY dart run supadart'
scripts.generate-types:local: dotenvx run --quiet -f ../../.env.generated -f ../../.env -- sh -c 'SUPABASE_URL=$API_URL SUPABASE_API_KEY=$SECRET_KEY dart run supadart'
